criteria: Three matched truth-acquisition checkpoints only: near / b / c at their last closed work before park. Must independently reproduce recorded camera and TCP readback, native RGB-D, high RGB-D, exact nodes, edge flags, central faces, grip, tick and real cut count of the reference. Apply exactly the original guarded clear_view(.003) retaining closed jaws; if refused or tearing, over-budget, or connectivity/grasp/cut-event mismatch, retain failed probe. Observe on a new simulation tick with the actual tool still in frame and NOT parked (>0.5 mm from ready). Only complete raw+noisy blind verdicts qualify the matched pair; diagnostic pinhole geometry, predicted corners or part recolouring must not enter the classifier.
attribution: For each missing or unproven cut face, predefine a 2x2 factorial attribution, scorer-only: require the same 2x2 through-depth patch and threshold as the locked image predicate. O=observed cap box around decoded corners+measured flank depth bounds; I=privileged exact projected corner or vertex depth. Count faces with blocks at (O,O),(I,O),(O,I),(I,I) separately on the current clear observation. Explicitly identify missing corner patches vs present but unbounded, 2D uncertainty vs depth failure. An ideal replacement is a diagnostic upper bound and cannot pass the image gate. No further look variations, holdout or control on refusal.
